notes.title: Update 0.3.0 (The Scenario Mode)
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone! Hope everyone is having a great weekend! This update is a pretty big one, so let's see whats changed!

[h2]Whats new?[/h2]
This update introduces the scenario mode! This mode allows you to use ships build in sandbox or the steam workshop and create scenes from them! You can move or rotate the ships in any way you would like to! You can also select and move multiple ships at the same time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841280/a7c0428d28cab27132c9c4e082db1f67ad8624f3.gif[/img]

This mode also has the option to load or save your scenarios so you can edit your scenarios for later!

[h3]Time Scale[/h3]

You have the ability to slow down, and even stop the scene, allowing you to move the camera around to observe the battle in a very high detail! The scale can be changed using buttons or +/- on the keyboard.

Example of timescale
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841280/fa301c5479156972df685fa3b036f844bde45979.gif[/img]

[h3]High resolution Screenshots[/h3]

In this mode, you have the option to take high resolution screenshots! Available resolutions are 8K, 5K 4K, and 1080p. This allows you to create very high detail photos of your scene! The format is in jpg and might add the option to toggle different file types.

4K example
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841280/e6192478b1b5c76d7111a3e79eeda8d5a4b9fe27.jpg[/img]

[h3]Other Features[/h3]
Here are some of the other small features that are in this mode!
-Ability to set AI teams
-Ability to toggle the planet
-Ability to set the sun rotation/movement
-Ability to undo or redo ship positioning/rotation
-Ability to modify the planet

Demo has been updated with the new graphics as well.

Video Trailer
[previewyoutube=98gS-8DwOes;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 0.2.15 (Minor Graphics Update, New Parts, and Bug Fixes)
notes.notes:
Hope everyone's having a great January, I know I am, and now for the new goodies!

[h1]Minor Graphics Updates[/h1]
I've added some more graphical improvements to parts and thrusters!  

[h2]Changes to Parts[/h2]
I've added a normal texture to all blocks, allowing for more detail to parts and weapons. In future versions, I will eventually add more selection in textures and possibly a way to use custom textures.

[h3]Before[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841280/85db20eddcc4d97299f855d93681bce189ea8da2.png[/img]
[h3]After[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841280/3e41cb5f7390fc863d22087ab4ebb61ac27e10e8.png[/img]
[h2]Changes to Thrusters[/h2]
I have changed the effect to better suit the shape of the thruster model. On top of that, I have added the ability to change the color on your thrusters to be any RGB value you choose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841280/aa8ed122f7abf335205d0f3d6b86c77733620fdd.gif[/img]

[h2]Debris![/h2]
Also a small feature that i have added is debris! This effect adds more life to blocks that have been destroyed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841280/13fb56690ffedcee47d4cba693e5494fb3013442.gif[/img]

[h1]New Parts[/h1]
In this update, I have only added two new parts, Sloped Thrusters in light and heavy variants! These new thrusters allow for more sleeker builds and more variations of thruster setups!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841280/87a91ca559fca801fca12e53f0b7bceda7172c04.png[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

A few minor bugs have been fixed in this update, including global leaderboards not loading properly.

[h1]What is next?[/h1]

The next update will include the addition of the scenario mode! In this mode you can place ships in any way you and and any team you want!

Here's a preview of ship positioning and rotation!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841280/ee8bba7b6cbe95425bb71809ca9b995fa50a6391.gif[/img]

I'll see y'all in the next update!

notes.title: Update 0.2.11 (Leaderboards, QOL changes, Bug Fixes)
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas Everyone!!

Here are some goodies to bring forth the Christmas Cheer!

[h1]New Additions[/h1]

-Added Steam Leaderboards!

The leaderboards keeps and ranks your scores that you gain in the PVE mode. You gain points based on the damage that you do to other ships and you lose points when die/respawn. The points lost is based on the max health of your ship to keep that in mind.

[h1]Quality of Life Changes[/h1]

I've added the ability to change the color to the UI!

This addition allows players to set the UI color to their choosing!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

I've fixed a few bugs related to turret's.

Previously, lasers would often go beserk and just flair around. That was not the intended usage.
Now lasers and other weapons focus on their block rather than just jumping around.


[h1]What's next?[/h1]

The next major thing that will be added is the Scenario mode!

This mode will allow you to place ships into various positions and teams and have the AI fight each other. There will be an option to save your scenarios so you can edit or come back to them at a later date. 

The next update will have more PVE modes added as well, in addition of difficulty levels, with more details to come!

Hope everyone is having fun in this game and I hope to hear your suggestions!

Merry Christmas and I'll see everyone in the next decade!

notes.title: Weekly Friday Update #2 (09/27/2019)
notes.notes:
Hello Builders!

This is the very first update as to progress, showcases, and any other general updates!

[b]Progress[/b]
An interesting thing that I've come across is that players love building larger ships.

Well this week i have a solution to that, introducing, multi cubes with a size of 2*2*2, or 1*2*1. This allows players to have longer and sleeker ships to build with, such as art ships or combat focused ships, no the less, there are a lot of exciting things to come.

[b]Showcase[/b]

While there is much to discuss about what the game currently has, there is nothing as important as shields. While I am still balancing the shields out, let me talk about how they work.

A single shield part does not mean its a separate shield, no. In fact the shields stack in a compound way. The more shields you add, the larger shield capacity and recharge rate becomes, however don't forget the fact that shields consume a lot of energy.

While in combat, players are able to toggle their shields at will, but when turning off the shield, the shield health or "Bank" is reduced to zero and have to be turned on to start recharging. If a shield is damaged to zero, the shield takes 30 seconds to "recycle" itself before the shields can be turned on again. Of course community feedback is apprecieated. 


[b]To The Community[/b]

While this game is small, I am working on this game on a regular basis with constant updates and bug fixes. What would really help me is community feedback and for players who might be interested in this game, to wish list it or follow it or better yet, share the existence of this game to people who would be interested.


Happy building,
Crazyyivan97

notes.title: Weekly Friday Update #1 (09/20/2019)
notes.notes:
Hello Builders!

This is the very first update as to progress, showcases, and any other general updates! 

[b]Progress[/b]

Question, how do you make a ship more squishy or sponge more damage? SHIELDS!!

This week I have introduced shields to the game with a temporary model. How do they work? Well it's simple, shields work on a generated charge. Players are able to toggle their ships shields, however, the charge is reset to zero each time a player turns off their shields and require to be recharged back to full health. Also if a shield is damaged to zero, the shield will have a 30 second cool down before recharging again.

[b]Showcase[/b]

As I continue to add more weapons and parts to the game, I will often write showcases about new or revamped weapons.

This week I will be showcasing the tier 1 missile system. While this name is generic, I do intend to rename weapons to sound more systematic and interesting. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841280/c1a04c1ee255600d979b2d8424b6b06afe18390e.gif[/img]

How do the missiles work? Well it's quite simple, when a player targets an enemy ship and the missile system can see the ship, the missile system will fire a full salvo of tracking missiles. Currently I am still balancing the missile turning, speed and damage but different missile systems will serve different specialties.

[b]To The Community[/b]

While this game is small, I am working on this game on a regular basis with constant updates and bug fixes. What would really help me is community feedback and for players who might be interested in this game, to wish list it or follow it or better yet, share the existence of this game to people who would be interested. 

Happy building,
Crazyyivan97
